functions.name: eden_room
functions.title: Eden live room
functions.description: Read and drive Eden's one persistent live avatar room: her current session, seconds left, credits, and the join room. Use action=state to see what is open, action=keep to open her room or renew it before the vendor ceiling closes it (call this every time she needs to stay live), action=stop to end every open room.

action.description: state = the room that is actually open plus credits. keep = create a room when none is open, otherwise return the live one and roll it over just before it expires. start = always open a new session. stop = end every open room.

sandbox.description: Free 60-second sandbox session. Defaults to false, which is live and bills per minute.

functions.name: guardian_run
functions.title: Guardian trust pass
functions.description: The app's own verification and self-healing engine. action=state returns the trust score, every probe result, open findings and queued briefs. action=verify makes a real call per installed capability. action=audit inspects the records. action=heal runs one named repair. action=evolve turns open findings into build briefs. action=resolve closes a finding.

action.description: state is a pure read and costs nothing. verify calls live providers and takes a few seconds.

repair.description: heal only. Pass exactly one of: loop.unstick, sessions.reap, shares.revoke, lives.close.

finding_id.description: resolve only: the GuardianFinding id to close.

functions.name: studio_task
functions.title: Studio task
functions.description: Run work in the app's own studio engine and read it back. action=create starts a real run and returns its task_id, action=detail returns the task with its activity, action=send adds a follow-up, action=stop halts it, action=list searches tasks, action=artifacts lists what it produced.

action.description: create starts a run; detail, send, stop and artifacts all need task_id.

instruction.description: create only: the brief, 1 to 6000 characters.

title.description: create only: a short title, up to 120 characters.

task_id.description: detail, send, stop and artifacts: the task to act on.

message.description: send only: the follow-up message, up to 4000 characters.

project_id.description: create only: optional project to build inside.

agent_id.description: create only: optional StudioAgent id to run as.

model.description: create and send: optional model id.

effort.description: create and send: how hard the run should think.

query.description: list only: case-insensitive match on title and instruction.

status.description: list only: running, waiting, stopped or error.

cursor.description: list only: the cursor from a previous page.

functions.name: railway_stack
functions.title: Railway stack
functions.description: The Railway side of this project: the owned browser container, its latest deployment, its health and its ledger tables. action=status reads the deployment and host health, action=railway.up redeploys the container from its latest commit (blocks about 45 seconds), action=supabase.migrate creates or repairs the ledger tables, action=verify.all opens a real browser on the container and proves the loop end to end.

action.description: status is a read and safe to call any time. railway.up redeploys and blocks. verify.all opens and releases one real browser session.

functions.name: browser_host
functions.title: Owned browser on Railway
functions.description: Drive the browser this project owns and runs on Railway: open a session, act in the page (goto, click, fill, extract text, screenshot), read the live view, run agents and read their runs, and read host usage. Use action=host.status for the host's real counters, action=registry.list for every action, then any action with params.

action.description: registry.list, host.status, usage.get, sessions.create, sessions.list, sessions.get, sessions.act, sessions.debug, sessions.logs, sessions.downloads, sessions.release, contexts.create, contexts.get, contexts.delete, projects.get, projects.update, agents.list, agents.create, agents.get, agents.update, agents.delete, runs.create, runs.list, runs.get, runs.stop, runs.resume, runs.messages, runs.files.

params.description: The action's own inputs: session_id, run_id, agent_id, context_id, task, limit, status, timeout_seconds, keep_alive, allowed_domains, page_action and that action's inputs (url, selector, text, value, key, delta, ms).

functions.name: x1_os_bridge
functions.title: X1 Operating System bridge
functions.description: The contract the X1 Operating System uses to reach this factory, and the same surface a connected client can use. action=status returns live counts for tasks, projects, templates, open findings and the latest benchmark; task.list, task.get and task.create read and start studio runs; finding.list returns open guardian findings.

action.description: ping is a health check. status is the live counts. task.create starts a real run.

limit.description: task.list and finding.list: how many to return, 1 to 20.

status.description: task.list only: filter by task status, e.g. running, stopped, error.

instruction.description: task.create only: the brief, 1 to 6000 characters.

effort.description: task.create only: how hard the run should think.

project_id.description: task.create only: optional project to build inside.

owner_id.description: task.create only: who the run belongs to. Omit to use the workspace admin.
